notes: New eval/whist-involution.c: anneals Z_v base rounds invariant under an involutive multiplier m (moves (p q)(mp mq) commute with m). Rule found on small cases: m = 1 mod 3 and -1 mod the other prime (21: 13, 33: 10 find designs in 2-10 s; 8 and 23 do not in 10 s). At 57, m=37: found in 10.6-15.0 CPU-s in 4 of 4 seeds that finished (other 4 stopped). checkWhist passes on the developed design. Page effect at 57 players/14 courts seed 57: repeat partners 87 -> 0, unmet 87 -> 0, opponents 0-5 -> exactly 2. Checks run: node --test whist.test.mjs (19 pass), node --test calc.test.mjs page.test.mjs (242 pass), check_posts ok, venture-preflight clean (exit 0). No agent doc in docs/reports: README section and flagships next carry what the next run needs. Same rule past the page cap: 69 (m=22) found in 100 CPU-s and re-checked in Python; 77 (m=43, 34) not found in 120 s (eval/whist-involution-over64.txt). Merge with main: #17790 (Singer plane, eval/whist-singer.c) landed first; whist-bases.mjs keeps its 57 base (build order), post rewritten as a second-route post, flagships next merged.
